about: Memory regions beyond each corpus image's own bytes, added to manifest.json's (which lists only what build.py tells the loaders) for scoring region detection (scripts/detect_cases.py, docs/autodetect.md). 'regions': true regions, exact, added to the manifest's. 'partial': windows of the board's memory map the true regions lie somewhere in (kind ram, mmio, or any: either, or neither, such as ROM), scored for found and false only. Every entry names its source.

regions.source: the System Control Space (ARMv7-M architecture): corpus/firmware/src/fwkit/arch/cortexm.c reads CFSR at 0xe000ed28; the FreeRTOS GCC/ARM_CM3 port (firmware.json) programs SysTick at 0xe000e010-0xe000e018 and the SCB's priorities and ICSR at 0xe000ed04-0xe000ed20
as fwkit-cortexm3-O2: arch/cortexm.c and the FreeRTOS GCC/ARM_CM3 port
